anchor.scope: Causal normalized accepted-target residual anchor; every fresh continuation step applies independent of future fixture/target labels. Forced-chain steps excluded. GPU counts reconstructed from chain kind/readiness/n_out.

local_target.limits: Agreement is local to each verified forced context; never global greedy survival beyond a raw/fixture divergence. Local raw prefix stops at its first mismatch and is right-censored by forced-prefix/output bounds. Chain labels are not scored here; forced chain inputs are teacher-forced. No free-generation quality claim.

quality.limits: Prefix labels stop at first mismatch and request budget. Full1024 bank availability is used only for GPU counter reconstruction, never for out-of-budget quality labels. Conditional forced-context diagnostic, no global free quality or independent probability product.

top2.limits: Forced-zero is a subset of forced, never fresh. Rank2 is observed but unexecuted. Raw labels describe the actual forced target context; observations at or before first global divergence share only the recorded prior target prefix, not a demonstrated free-generation run.

row_budget_arithmetic.formula: delta = I(rank2 matches first target) - I(primary joint prefix survives depth rows-1)
row_budget_arithmetic.limits: Same fresh-chain states and full in-budget row cohort; p1 bins fixed before results. Raw labels beyond a matched raw token that leaves the forced prefix are unknown and bounded, never assigned zero. This is an emission arithmetic diagnostic, not scheduler replay, a throughput bound or a tree implementation. Low-confidence actual T1 windows do not already pay for 3/4 rows; added branches need parent-aware state and measured marginal work.

validation_limits: Snapshot integrity only; model correctness and performance untested.
CUDA/runtime DLLs outside the build folder are supplied by existing config.

preregistered_stop: Close this alpha if no repeatable benefit or more than2% regression in a case; no after-the-fact alpha sweep.
limits: Instrumented host-observation trace with oracle off and forced IDs; not uninstrumented performance or free-generation quality.
Expert auto cache and elasticity are retained: capacity/tier drift remains an observed confounder.
Warmup/smoke are not performance results. Anchor uses accepted past state only; target forcing is benchmark control. TOP2 labels are local forced-context observations, not free quality.
Causal anchor does not read future labels; target forcing, TOP2 and policy trace are laboratory instrumentation shared by both arms.
Alpha0 is exact no-write in the step hook but retains allocation, seed and hook launches. This is not an uninstrumented baseline comparison.
First-head direct computation is unchanged. Later heads may differ through altered own KV/history; global first-head equality between arms is not assumed.
All proposal survival stops at first mismatch and budget. Raw labels following departure from the forced path are not treated as known alternative-path labels.

TOP2 recovery is a measured marginal event; joint primary-prefix survival is counted directly. No products of marginal probabilities, fitted confidence threshold or prospective tree speedup are reported.
Fixed3/4-row arithmetic does not imply the adaptive scheduler currently pays those rows. Actual first-use window widths are supplied, including T1 and unused heads.
Automatic target cache resizing is retained. Capacity, prefix read/upload, prefill and wall timers are reported without addition or subtraction.
Positive instrumented fixed-continuation results require subsequent untraced free-generation validation; no free-quality claim.
